# agent-sandbox

> Self-hostable, disposable sandboxes where AI agents run code, with snapshot, rollback, and fork. A Python server with a REST API, a Python SDK (`agent_sandbox.client`, depends only on httpx), and an MCP server (`agent-sandbox-mcp`), running hardened Docker containers on your own Linux host. Install with `pip install sic-agent-sandbox`, the `install.sh` script, or the `ghcr.io/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox` image.

- [Backends](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/docs/backends.md): the backend contract and the Docker implementation
- [Decision records](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/tree/main/docs/adr)
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, and rules for contributors

## Source

- [api.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/api.py): FastAPI routes, auth, NDJSON streaming
- [manager.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/manager.py): lifecycle, quotas, TTL reaping, snapshots
- [backends/base.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/backends/base.py): the Backend interface
- [backends/docker.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/backends/docker.py): hardened Docker backend
- [client.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/client.py): Python SDK
- [mcp_server.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/mcp_server.py): MCP tools
- [config.py](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-sandbox/blob/main/src/agent_sandbox/config.py): every AGENT_SANDBOX_* setting
